route.live.permissionBody: When you press Start, the phone asks for your location. OpenHoop uses it only while this activity records and the app is open, never in the background. The route is stored on this phone and never uploaded.
route.live.denied: Location is not allowed, so no route can be recorded. You can allow it in the phone settings, or record heart rate only.
route.live.approximate: Precise location is off for OpenHoop, and an approximate location is too rough for a route. Allow precise location in the phone settings, or record heart rate only.
route.live.unavailable: GPS could not be started on this phone, so no route is recorded. Check that location services are on.
route.live.keepOpen: Keep OpenHoop open on screen: the route is recorded only while the app is in the foreground.
route.title: Route
route.none: No route for this activity. Start an activity with a route to record one.
route.tooShortHidden: The route is too short to show anything with 200 m around its start and end hidden.
route.hideEnds: Hide 200 m around the start and end
route.hideEndsBody: Hides where you started and stopped wherever the route is shown, also where the route passes there again. The stored route and your data export keep every point.
route.mapOff: No map background: map tiles need the network. Switch on Network features and Maps under Privacy to load them. The route itself is drawn on the phone.
route.gaps: GPS was paused or lost {count} times. Distance counts only the recorded parts.
route.estimate: From the phone GPS. Distance, pace and elevation gain are estimates.
network.maps.title: Maps
network.maps.sends: Sends: the numbers of the map tiles around a saved route when you open it, which show roughly where the route was, plus your IP address and the app name and version. The route itself is never sent.
network.maps.to: To: the OpenStreetMap Foundation (tile.openstreetmap.org), under its privacy policy. Tiles load only while you look at a saved route; nothing is downloaded in advance.
route.accuracyLabel: Route distance, pace and elevation gain
